actions.script: def bill=ec.entity.find('mantle.account.invoice.Invoice').condition('invoiceId',invoiceId).one() def taxable=BigDecimal.ZERO,tax=BigDecimal.ZERO,cgst=BigDecimal.ZERO,sgst=BigDecimal.ZERO,igst=BigDecimal.ZERO,cess=BigDecimal.ZERO ec.entity.find('mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceItem').condition('invoiceId',invoiceId).list().each { line -> taxable+=(line.taxableAmount != null ? line.taxableAmount : (line.quantity ?: 0)*(line.amount ?: 0)-(line.discountAmount ?: 0)) as BigDecimal tax+=(line.totalTaxAmount != null ? line.totalTaxAmount : (line.cgstAmount ?: 0)+(line.sgstAmount ?: 0)+(line.igstAmount ?: 0)+(line.cessAmount ?: 0)) as BigDecimal cgst+=(line.cgstAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal;sgst+=(line.sgstAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal;igst+=(line.igstAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal;cess+=(line.cessAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal } def grand=taxable+tax def roundOff=bill.currencyUomId=='INR' ? grand.setScale(0,java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP)-grand : BigDecimal.ZERO def words=bill.currencyUomId=='INR' ? ec.service.sync().name('zenith.base.LocalizationServices.convert#AmountToWords').parameters([amount:grand+roundOff,currencyUomId:bill.currencyUomId,organizationPartyId:bill.toPartyId]).call() : null // SOP convention: stored grand is unrounded and tax-inclusive; round-off stays separate. // This service edits draft lines only. Payments and their applications are a separate workflow. ec.service.sync().name('update#mantle.account.invoice.Invoice').parameters([invoiceId:invoiceId, invoiceTotal:grand,unpaidTotal:grand-(bill.appliedPaymentsTotal ?: 0),totalTaxableAmount:taxable, totalTaxAmount:tax,totalCgst:cgst,totalSgst:sgst,totalIgst:igst,totalCess:cess,roundOffAmount:roundOff,amountInWords:words?.amountInWords]).call()
